messages:
Rina: Kickoff: marketplace listing for three-cloud GA + optional Private(KMS) add-on. Need leads for: partner logo license, SI integration badge text, KMS customer-managed-key docs, and promo coupon handling. Goal: staging request next Tue.
Noor: I can do asset pack + localization (EN/FR/DE). Where do we host final images? Shared drive or publisher portal?
Diego: Legal: will own logo/license check + privacy + export-control note. Also need to review any phrasing that mentions the SI by name.
Linh: Eng: I'll draft minimal IAM + CMK attach examples for AWS/GCP/Azure and a terraform snippet for publishers. Also confirm which GPU families we advertise.
Sam: Product: packaging + SKU naming. Thinking SKUs: RWD-MKT-BASE, RWD-MKT-PRO-TRIAL, RWD-MKT-PRIVATE-KMS. Keep public names friendly.
marketplace-bot: :pushpin: New manifest template uploaded: https://redwood.internal/marketplace/manifests/onboard-v5.md (rev 1765000000)
Rina: Two constraints from partner: 1) co-branded tile must be approved before embargo release; 2) SI wants a "Verified integration" badge on the listing. Need legal OK on badge wording.
Diego: Draft badge text: "Verified deployment with [SI Name]". I'll check trademark/use rights and update the manifest checkbox.
Noor: Upload path: /Shared/marketplace/onboards/1765054321/assets. I'll include hero (1200x628), two logos, 3 screenshots per locale.
Linh: IAM example (GCP) to include in manifest:
```
resource "google_service_account" "pub_sa" {
  account_id = "rwd-pub-sa"
}

# Grant minimal viewer + storage access
# roles/storage.objectViewer, roles/compute.viewer
```
Sam: Packaging note: keep pricing hidden behind CTA for co-markets. Public bullets only. For the Private KMS SKU, add a short ops note about key rotation responsibilities.
Diego: Also add a "third-party model disclosure" checkbox if we reference specific model families in the feature list.
Rina: Action items recap:
- Noor: asset pack + localized screenshots (48h)
- Sam: SKU sheet + packaging draft (24h)
- Linh: IAM + terraform snippets + supported HW note (48h)
- Diego: legal badge/license + privacy_manifest check (72h)
marketplace-bot: :warning: Compliance requires privacy_manifest.pdf and partner_logo_license.pdf uploaded before staging.
Noor: Quick Q: should localized screenshots include translated CTAs? I can make two sets — one with English CTAs and one fully localized.
Sam: Fully localized please for FR/DE. We want the listing to read native.
Linh: One infra gotcha: for Private(KMS) SKUs we need to document a failed-provisioning rollback path when the publisher-managed key denies actions. I'll add a short troubleshooting blurb.
Diego: Legal: will we publish "Data residency: EU available" toggle? If so I need to confirm language for EU customers.
Rina: Yes, include the toggle. Diego, please draft the exact sentence we'll use.
Noor: Scheduling: can we do a 30-min review Friday 11:00 AM PT to walk assets + manifest?
Sam: Works for me.
Diego: I'll attend.
Linh: I'll be there.
Rina: Thanks team — I'll create the shared folder and post link + manifest stub here when ready. :rocket:
